scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Finally I've found you, Vagabond Spike! Your neck is mine!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
总算找到你了，浪人斯派克！
你的脑袋，我要定了！

scripts.text: Say what?
scripts.translation: 你说什么？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
*Snort* Don't pretend like you don't know. Look at this poster! You're in it!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
哼，别装蒜！看看这张通缉令，画的就是你！

scripts.text: I see the resemblance, but that's not me.
scripts.translation: 我看确实有几分相似，但那不是我

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Forget the resemblance. Where did you get that poster? I've never committed a crime.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
先别管像不像，这通缉令哪儿来的？
我可没犯过罪。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I knew you'd try to lie your way out.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我就知道你会试图撒谎脱身。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
The ^0000ffEinbroch Private Pub^000000 has released that wanted poster. You have many bounty hunters like me on your heels.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
^0000ff艾音布罗克私人酒馆^000000发布了那张通缉令。像我这样的赏金猎人正追在你身后。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I don't care if you're the right one so long as you look it and I can take you dead or alive.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
管你是不是，只要长得像，死的活的我都能拿去交差。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
It's you again! You've got guts to come back here!
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
又是你！你居然敢回来！

scripts.text: Make a run for it.
scripts.translation: 逃跑

scripts.text: Fight him.
scripts.translation: 战斗

scripts.text: ^0000ffI should run for now and think about this later.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff先跑再说，之后再想办法。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffHe's not the only bounty hunter after me, if he's telling the truth. I need time to strategize.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff如果他说的是真的，盯上我的赏金猎人可不止一个，得从长计议。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
No loitering around the venue.
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
禁止在场地附近逗留。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Under construction, can't get in.
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
正在施工，无法进入。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
*Gasp* You! I thought you were already captured. Ooh, doesn't matter now. You're my Get Out of Jail Free card!
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
嘶...是你！还以为你早被逮住了。
嘿，不过这下好了，你就是我的免罪金牌！

scripts.text: I'm not the criminal you think I am!
scripts.translation: 我不是你以为的那个罪犯！

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
You aren't?
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
你不是？

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe bouncer examines your face.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff看场人打量着你的脸。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Hm, you bear a striking resemblance, though you don't look not as menacing as that criminal Spike
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
嗯，你长得确实很像，不过你看起来不像那个罪犯斯派克那么凶恶。

scripts.text: I want to talk to the poster publisher.
scripts.translation: 我要见发布通缉令的人

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Your problem is a bit out of my league. Get in. If I find out you're the real deal all along, I'll see that you'll never see the outside again.
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
这事我管不了，进去吧。
但要是让我发现你真是那个罪犯，就别想再出去了。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
You're back. Why?
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
你又回来了。为什么？

scripts.text: I want in.
scripts.translation: 我要进去

scripts.text: I was passing by.
scripts.translation: 我只是路过

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
你真傻。

scripts.text:
[Bouncer]
Go ahead. Stay out of trouble.
scripts.translation:
[看场人]
去吧。别惹麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Ruthless Rebellion]
Do you know how to use a gun?
scripts.translation:
[冷酷的反叛者]
你会用枪吗？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Gunslinger]
...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的神枪手]
...

scripts.text:
[Quiet Gunslinger]
Don't say I look like a blacksmith you know.
scripts.translation:
[沉默的神枪手]
别说我长得像你认识的某个铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Drunken Man]
*Hiccups* Oh, I'm the owner here.
Oh wait, am I in the pub or someplace else? Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[醉汉]
嗝...哦，我是这儿的老板。
等等，这儿是酒馆还是哪儿来着？呼噜...

scripts.text:
[Anxious Man]
Maybe I'm in the wrong place. This place doesn't look like a pub.
scripts.translation:
[焦虑的男子]
也许我走错地方了。这里看起来不像酒吧。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Do you want to see the boss?
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
你想见老板吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Are you looking for me?
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
你在找我吗？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
What do you want?
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
你想要什么？

scripts.text: I'm mistaken for a criminal!.
scripts.translation: 我被误认为是罪犯了！

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Wait a minute... Mwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
等一下...哇哈哈！

scripts.text: ^0000ffHe scans your face, then guffaws.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff他看了看你的脸，然后大笑起来。^000000

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
I'm sorry. For a moment, I thought Spike came back to life. He was found dead three days ago.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
抱歉。刚才一瞬间，我以为斯派克复活了。他三天前被发现死了。

scripts.text: He was captured already?
scripts.translation: 他已经被抓住了？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Yes, and the bounty hunter was already paid. The news hasn't spread, and you're the spitting image of him. Go figure.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
抓到了，赏金也发了。
不过消息还没传开，你又和他长得一模一样，难怪会这样。

scripts.text: You have to do something!
scripts.translation: 你得做点什么！

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
I'm sorry, but I can't talk to every single bounty hunter for you. Of course, I'm willing to compensate for your inconvenience.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
抱歉，总不能让我挨个去跟赏金猎人解释吧。
不过，给你添了麻烦，我愿意补偿。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Hey, how about you join our ranks? At the very last, you won't get shot.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
嘿，要不要加入我们？至少这样，你就不会被枪打了。

scripts.text: You want me become a bounty hunter?
scripts.translation: 你想让我成为赏金猎人？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
No, bounty hunting is just a pastime. We're the experts of all the firearms in the world.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
不，捉拿通缉犯只是消遣。
我们精通世上各式枪械。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Carefree spirits!
Magical spitfires!
We call ourselves the ^0000ffRebellion^000000.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
自由不羁的灵魂！
魔法般的枪火！
我们自称^0000ff反叛者^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
You look like you know how to use a gun. How'd you like to join our ranks? You won't have to worry about other bounty hunters anymore too.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
你看起来像是知道怎么用枪。要不要加入我们？这样你也不用再担心其他赏金猎人了。

scripts.text: Let me think it over.
scripts.translation: 让我考虑一下

scripts.text: I don't think I have a choice.
scripts.translation: 我觉得我没得选

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
You can think it over and over, but the answer won't change. Just take the offer.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
你可以考虑再考虑，但答案不会变。就接受这个提议吧。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Good thinking. Might as well do it now and get it over with.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
明智，不如现在就办，早点了结。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Talk to Enwin Conick. She guides drifting spirits like you to the way of the Rebellion. I'll send word to her. Ah, and don't point your gun at her.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
去找埃尔温·科尼克吧，她会指引你这样的漂泊者走上反叛者的道路。
我会打个招呼。
对了，别把枪口对着她。

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Do you have business with Elwin Conick?
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
你要找埃尔温·科尼克吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不

scripts.text: Send me to Elwin Conick.
scripts.translation: 带我去找埃尔温·科尼克

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
All right. Care for a shot of vodka?
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
好的。想喝点伏特加吗？

scripts.text:
[Kulbertinov]
Okay, I'll let her know.
scripts.translation:
[库尔贝尔蒂诺夫]
好，我会通知她的。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
如果你不想加入反叛者，就滚出去。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Do you to join us Rebellions?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你要加入我们反叛者吗？

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe short woman with keen eyes stares into your eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff那位目光锐利的矮个子女子凝视着你的眼睛。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Sign here.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
在这里签字。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe undersigned party '_____' will not speak of the test even if he or she suffers injury, mutilation, or death in an unforeseen accident that may occur during the test.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff签署人“_____”承诺，即使在测试中因不可预见的事故而受伤、致残或死亡，也不会透露测试的内容。^000000

scripts.text: WHAT?!
scripts.translation: 什么？！

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Do you want join us or not?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你到底要不要加入我们？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃了

scripts.text: ...I'll sign.
scripts.translation: ...我签

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Your choice.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Good. Now, follow me.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
很好。现在，跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Do you want to try again?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你想再试一次吗？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃了

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 开始吧

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Your choice.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Follow me.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
跟我来。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You still have Ivan's shooting test, do you want to try again?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你还有伊万的射击测试没完成，想再试一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ivan's shooting test have not finished yet, do you want to try again?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
伊万的射击测试还没结束，你想再试一次吗？

scripts.text: I give up.
scripts.translation: 我放弃了

scripts.text: Do it.
scripts.translation: 开始吧

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
现在放弃不值得，出去放松一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Remember to give your best.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
记住，要全力以赴。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ivan is waiting for you, go find him.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
伊万在等你，去找他吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You have no more test to take. Why don't you go out and have a drink?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你已经没有测试要参加了。不如出去喝一杯？

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
如果你不想加入反叛者，就滚出去。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou are already in the test form. If you have finished all your tests, report to Elwin Conick in the Assembly Room^000000.
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你已经处于测试变身状态。若已完成全部测试，请到组装室向埃尔温·科尼克报到^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Look at yourself, do you really want to test?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
看看你自己，你真的想参加测试吗？

scripts.text: ^0000ffElwin see you turn into another form and she is very angry. Wait for your current form ends, and then find her again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff埃尔温看见你变成别的模样，很不高兴。等变身结束再来找她吧。^000000

scripts.text: Wait.
scripts.translation: 等待

scripts.text: Go away.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Come back when you aren't in any form.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
等你恢复正常形态后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
现在放弃不值得，出去放松一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Any leftover Steel Artifacts must be returned after the test.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
测试结束后，剩余的铁制加工品必须归还。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Any leftover Steel Artifacts must be returned after the test.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
测试结束后，剩余的铁制加工品必须归还。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Time over. You failed the test. Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
时间到。你测试失败了。把剩下的测试材料都交给我。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Listen up. I'm not going to great lengths trying to explain the test to you.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
听好了，测试说明我只简单说一遍。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
This is where the firearm molds are cast. Everywhere you can see Steel Artifacts are being produced.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
这里是枪械模具铸造区，到处都在生产铁制加工品。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll be asked to control switches on the machine and select 5 standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你需要操作机器上的开关，并选出5个标准的铁制加工品。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
We Rebellions are weapon experts at heart. Here you will learn to create and assemble firearms.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
我们反叛者天生就是武器专家。在这里，你将学习如何制造和组装枪械。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll be asked to control the furnace controller near the entrance and select 5 standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
你需要操作入口附近的熔炉控制器，并选出5个标准的铁制加工品。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll then take them to the next Assembly Room and assemble them info a firearm. You'll be given 3 minutes to do all that. You'd better be fast and focused, or you will fail the test.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
带着它们去隔壁组装室，装出一把枪。
全部步骤只有3分钟，手要快，注意力要集中，否则就算失败。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
I'll be in the next room, waiting for you to bring me a complete firearm. To check the elapsed time, you'll be transformed into a different job. ^0000ffIf you pass 3 minutes and turn back to normal, go back to me and start the test again.^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
我在隔壁等你把成品枪带来。
为了计时，会让你变成其他职业的模样。
^0000ff3分钟后恢复原状，就回来找我，重新开始测试。^000000

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
You'll then take them to the next Assembly Room and assemble them into a complete firearm. You'll be given 3 minutes to finish all that. ^0000ffTo check the elapsed time, you'll be transformed into a different job^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
把加工品带到隔壁组装室，装出一把完整的枪，限时3分钟。
^0000ff为了计时，会让你变成其他职业的模样^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
I'll be in the next room, waiting for you to bring me a complete firearm. Remember, ^0000ffyou fail the test when your transformation expires after 3 minutes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
我在隔壁等你带成品枪过来。
记住，^0000ff3分钟后变身结束，就算测试失败^000000。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ah? Are you lost? You need to register first and then get back here.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
啊？你迷路了？你需要先注册，然后再回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
If you don't want to join Rebellions, just get out.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
如果你不想加入反叛者，就滚出去。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Are you done? I don't see any completed firearm in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
做完了？你的物品栏里可没见到成品枪。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's shoddy but not bad, given the time. You passed.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
做工粗糙了点，不过时间这么紧，也算不错。
通过。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
把剩下的测试材料都交给我。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Now you can move on to the next course. Ivan Sidorenko will oversee your test.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
现在你可以进入下一门课程了。伊万·西多连科将负责监督你的测试。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Look at yourself, do you really want to test?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
看看你自己，你真的想参加测试吗？

scripts.text: ^0000ffElwin see you turn into another form and she is very angry. Wait for your current form ends, and then find her again.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff埃尔温看见你变成别的模样，很不高兴。等变身结束再来找她吧。^000000

scripts.text: Wait.
scripts.translation: 等待

scripts.text: Go away.
scripts.translation: 离开

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Come back when you aren't in any form.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
等你恢复正常形态后再回来。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
It's not worth to give up, now go out and relax.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
现在放弃不值得，出去放松一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Time over. You failed the test. Let me take all your leftover test materials.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
时间到。你测试失败了。把剩下的测试材料都交给我。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Let's start again.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
让我们重新开始。

scripts.text:
[Elwin Conick]
Ah? Are you lost? You need to register first and then get back here.
scripts.translation:
[埃尔温·科尼克]
啊？你迷路了？你需要先注册，然后再回到这里。

scripts.text: Only authorized user can do the operation.
scripts.translation: 只有授权用户才能执行此操作。

scripts.text: Do you want to dredge the mold up from the furnace?
scripts.translation: 您要从熔炉中取出模具吗？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Begin.
scripts.translation: 开始

scripts.text: Switch to the Standby mode.
scripts.translation: 切换至待机模式

scripts.text: Initializing Furnace Controller ZX-3100...
scripts.translation: 正在初始化熔炉控制器 ZX-3100...

scripts.text: Not an authorized user. Abort the operation.
scripts.translation: 非授权用户。中止操作。

scripts.text: Only authorized user can do the operation.
scripts.translation: 只有授权用户才能执行此操作。

scripts.text: Unauthorized firearm creation has been detected. Report to Manager Elwin.
scripts.translation: 检测到未授权的枪械制造行为。请向管理员埃尔温报告。

scripts.text: You do not have standard Steel Artifacts.
scripts.translation: 您没有标准的铁制加工品。

scripts.text: Do you want to use the auto anvil and shape the standard Steel Artifacts into a firearm?
scripts.translation: 您要用自动铁砧将标准的铁制加工品塑造成枪械吗？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Begin.
scripts.translation: 开始

scripts.text: For your safety, please step away from the auto anvil.
scripts.translation: 为了您的安全，请远离自动铁砧。

scripts.text: You have successfully created a firearm using the auto anvil. ^ff0000Please report before your transformation expires^000000.
scripts.translation:
已使用自动铁砧成功制造出枪械。
^ff0000请在变身结束前报到^000000。

scripts.text: Failed to create a firearm.
scripts.translation: 枪械制造失败。

scripts.text: Not an authorized user. Abort the operation.
scripts.translation: 非授权用户。中止操作。

scripts.text: The system is busy dredging a completed mold from the furnace.
scripts.translation: 系统正忙于从熔炉中取出已完成的模具。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
This is shooting test area, you can't come here as you like.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
这里是射击测试区，你不能随意进入。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
There seems to be a mistake, you can't stay here.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
似乎出了点差错，你不能留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Hey, stay focused--we're using live ammo here, and you can get shot anytime.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
喂，集中精神！这里用的可都是真子弹，随时有可能挨枪子。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Let me make this quick. Basically you'll be running in this shooting range consisting of 5 sections.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
简单说，这个射击场分成5个区域，你得一路跑过去。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
The objective is to find enemies in the midst of a crowd quickly and without fail.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
目标是在人群中快速且准确地找到敌人。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Among all the targets, you must shoot only the ^0000ffStandard-issue Targets^000000. If you make a mistake, you'll lose points.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
所有靶子里，只能射击^0000ff标准目标^000000，打错要扣分。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Let's try. There aren't many ^0000ffStandard-issue Targets^000000, so keep your eyes peeled.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
让我们试试。^0000ff标准目标^000000并不多，所以请睁大眼睛。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
^0000ffYou have 3 minutes to finish this test. If you can't finish before your transformation expires^000000, you'll fail. If that happens, just follow the path back to me.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
^0000ff测试限时3分钟，必须在变身结束前完成^000000，否则就算失败。
失败了就沿路回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
^0000ffYou'll fail if you miss a Standard-issue Target, or shoot 3 incorrect targets^000000. Let's get started.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
^0000ff漏打标准目标，或打错3个目标，都会失败^000000。
开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Good job. I didn't think you could pass so quickly.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
干得好。我没想到你能这么快通过。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You may leave and wait outside. I'll bring other instructors' evaluation reports to see you.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
你可以离开，在外面等着。我会带着其他教官的评估报告来找你。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You're quick enough, but you shot too many incorrect targets. You failed.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
够快，可惜打错太多，失败。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You accurate enough, but you took too much time. Slow Rebellions don't survive long enough.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
够准，可是太慢。
动作迟缓的反叛者可活不长。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You failed at both speed and accuracy. How did you survive this long?
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
速度不行，准头也不行，你怎么活到现在的？

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
There's a problem, the statistic seems to be wrong. Well... This can happen sometimes.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
出了点问题，统计数据似乎有误。嗯...这种情况偶尔会发生。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Let's try again. Be more careful this time.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
让我们再试一次。这次请更小心些。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
How did you not leave?
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
你怎么还没离开？

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You may leave and wait outside. I'll bring other instructors' evaluation reports to see you.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
你可以离开，在外面等着。我会带着其他教官的评估报告来找你。

scripts.text: You have too many items, please reduce them to continue.
scripts.translation: 你的物品栏太满了，请整理物品以继续。

scripts.text: The items in your inventory are weighing you down. Lighten your weight first.
scripts.translation: 你背包里的物品太重了，影响了行动。请先减轻负重。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
There must have been a mistake. You aren't supposed to remain here.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
一定是搞错了。你不应该还留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Huh? You look so weak? I have nothing more to say.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
咦？你看起来好虚弱啊。我无话可说了。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Oh no~ You still have Skill Points.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
哎呀~你还有技能点没用完呢。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Kulbertinov, Elwin, and I've evaluated your Rebellion test results.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
库尔贝尔蒂诺夫、埃尔温和我已经评估了你的反叛者测试结果。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
And...
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
而且...

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
You've met all our requirements including the attitude and the test performance.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
不论态度还是测试表现，你都达到了我们的要求。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
That's right, you're now a member of the Rebellion. Get ready to be wowed.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
没错，从现在起，你就是反叛者的一员。
准备好大开眼界吧。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
And Elwin wants you to have this. Take good care of it. He made it for you.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
还有，埃尔温想把这个送给你。请好好保管。这是专门为你做的。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
回见。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
This life should be fun, not boring.
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
人生应该充满乐趣，而不是枯燥乏味。

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
And by becoming a Rebellion your life should be upgraded. So, go and create a great journey, make us proud!
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
成为反叛者，你的人生也该更上一层楼了。
去闯出一番天地，让我们为你骄傲吧！

scripts.text:
[Ivan Sidorenko]
Do you have something to say to me, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[伊万·西多连科]
你还有什么想对我说的吗？

scripts.text:
[Butler Karlex]
Use this temporary storage to keep your items safe while on the Advancement test.
scripts.translation:
[管家 卡莱克斯]
转职测试期间，可使用这个临时仓库保管物品。

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Open the storage.
scripts.translation: 打开仓库

scripts.text:
[Butler Karlex]
Thank you for using the service.
scripts.translation:
[管家 卡莱克斯]
感谢您使用服务。

scripts.text:
[Time Manager]
What time would you like to return?
scripts.translation:
[时间管理员]
你想在什么时间返回？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Test monster spawn
scripts.translation: 测试魔物生成

scripts.text: Start from beginning
scripts.translation: 从头开始

scripts.text: Furnace Zone
scripts.translation: 熔炉区域

scripts.text: Shooting Zone
scripts.translation: 射击区域

scripts.text: Complete the test
scripts.translation: 完成测试
